experiment_data.method_description: HeLa cells and Parkin WT inducible SH-SY5Y cells were pretreated with 100 nM bafilomycin A1 for 16 h. Dissipation of mitochondrial membrane potential was achieved with 10 mM (for HeLa) or 20 mM (for SH-SY5Y) CCCP for indicated time points.

negative_positive_control.negative_control_description: PINK1 siRNA-transfected cells or empty vector controls show no Parkin translocation and incomplete mitochondrial degradation.
negative_positive_control.positive_control_description: Cells transfected with PINK1 WT and EGFP-Parkin show robust Parkin mitochondrial translocation and mitochondrial clearance after CCCP treatment.
